CO-ROUTINE keys
  COMPOUND QUERY
    LEFT-MOST SUBQUERY
      MATERIALIZE q
        SCAN n CONSTANT ROWS
      SCAN q
    UNION USING TEMP B-TREE
      SCAN q
      SEARCH m USING INDEX memberships_reference (kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=?)
    UNION USING TEMP B-TREE
      CO-ROUTINE x
        SCAN n CONSTANT ROWS
      SCAN x
MATERIALIZE h
  SCAN n CONSTANT ROWS
SCAN keys
SCAN h
SEARCH l USING PRIMARY KEY (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=? AND record_id=?)
CORRELATED LIST SUBQUERY n
  SEARCH n USING COVERING INDEX direction_live_newest (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=? AND reach=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
